article_title: EF Core Specification 性能与翻译陷阱
core_theme: Specification 包住的「查询信封」在 provider 边界被翻译、在物化边界变成对象；性能问题必须用 SQL、命令数、耗时和行数这四件证据来定位，而不是给模式贴标签
reader_takeaway: 能按清单定位一条 specification 查询是翻译失败、物化过早、N+1、笛卡尔积还是上界失效，并知道全局过滤器和缓存键也要算进信封
summary_angle: 把一行看似无害的 ListAsync(specification) 拆成几道可以逐一检查的关卡：表达式在 provider 闸口被拦下、四件证据被读数、十条清单从外向内推进

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: an EF Core Specification query looks like one innocent line of code, but it must pass through several narrow checkable gates before rows come back, and each gate can be inspected and counted. The reader should quickly feel that query performance is diagnosed with concrete evidence rather than by blaming the pattern.

Summary angle: turn a single harmless-looking ListAsync(specification) call into a few gates that can each be inspected: the expression is stopped at the provider gate, four evidence readouts are collected, and a ten-step checklist proceeds inward.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- problem: an expression block is stopped at a narrow provider gate and bounces back with an error mark, because an unsupported helper method cannot be translated into SQL. Visible label: 翻译失败.
- evidence: four small readout blocks along the pipeline record the four pieces of evidence: generated SQL, command count, elapsed time, returned row count. Visible label: 四件证据, number chip 4.
- process: a numbered path of ten small checkpoints leads from the outer boundary inward toward the database. Visible label: 十条清单, number chip 10.

Main metaphor: a single harmless-looking call is actually a pipeline of narrow gates that a query must pass through, and every gate can be watched and counted.
Subject: a narrow provider gate checkpoint, with an expression block passing through it, flanked by small readout gauges.
Composition/framing: diagonal progression from lower-left toward upper-right in a wide cover, one dominant gate as the focal point plus three readable narrative beats. Prefer horizontal storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: 1990s retro animation look, cel-shaded color, analog grain, bold simple backgrounds, nostalgic broadcast texture. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: deep blue-grey, warm amber, cream off-white, a small teal accent.
Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary, all sourced from the information blocks. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters or one required product/model name. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: floating microchips, meaningless code rain, neon skyscraper backgrounds, generic robot poses, cyberpunk purple-blue glow, huge floating HUD layers.
